items.title: City Council meets
items.why: The outgoing council. By the usual pattern: Oct 15, Nov 5, Nov 19, Dec 3, Dec 17.

items.title: CharterCARE's revised plan for Roger Williams and Fatima hospitals due to the Attorney General
items.why: The Attorney General called the first plan unrealistic; the hospitals have about 40 days of cash.

items.title: Voter registration deadline

Brown reports its fiscal 2026 endowment return
items.why: The first year at the 4 percent federal endowment tax rate, up from 1.4 percent.

items.title: City Plan Commission filing deadline for the Nov 17 meeting
items.why: Brown's master plan amendment has to be filed by now to be heard Nov 17.

items.title: Second-quarter property tax due
Winter utility shutoff protections begin
items.why: Heating customers with balances under $500 are protected; arrears build until spring.

items.title: General election: mayor, all 15 council seats, Question 7
items.why: David Morales faces the general election for mayor; Question 7 would bar city investments tied to genocide or apartheid.

items.title: General election: governor, attorney general, legislature, $600 million in state bonds
WaterFire season finale
State revenue and caseload estimating conferences
items.why: Sizes the state's fiscal 2028 gap a week after the election.

items.title: City Plan Commission: Brown's master plan amendment for an economics building at Brook and Charlesfield
items.why: Two houses on Brook Street would be offered for relocation or demolished. Brown has said it will not give a housing count before the hearing. The date is the one Brown is aiming for.

items.title: One year since the shooting at Brown
items.why: Brown's safety action plan runs through 2026–27.

items.title: Tax assessment date; the City's fiscal 2026 audit is due
items.why: Providence has filed audits late before.

items.title: State minimum wage rises to $17; income-tax surcharge on millionaires begins
New mayor sworn in; new council elects a president
items.why: First Monday of January, by past practice.

items.title: Governor inaugurated; General Assembly convenes
Third-quarter property tax due
